info.name: Cyware Intel Exchange (CTIX) v3 Open Allowed Indicators API

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve indicators.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

params.name: type
params.description: Pass an allowed indicator type to filter the result. To retrieve the supported list of allowed indicator types, see the **GET List Supported Allowed Indicator Types API**.

params.name: created_by_id
params.description: Pass the ID of a user to filter records by the creator.

params.name: modified_by_id
params.description: Pass the ID of a user to filter records by the modifier.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Pass the created from time in epoch format to filter records based on the created time.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Pass the created time in epoch format to filter records based on the created time.

params.name: last_active_from
params.description: Pass the last active time in epoch format to filter records based on the last activity time.

params.name: last_active_to
params.description: Pass the last active to time in epoch format to filter records based on the last activity time.

params.name: sort
params.description: Pass `-created` to sort the result in descending order based on the created time. Pass `created` to sort the result in ascending order.
